decision1_ac6Reading.reading: AC-6 'actions the observation marks as form submission / navigation-causing' is enforced fail-closed as 'actions the observation cannot prove non-activating' for both DENY and CLARIFY_FIRST.
decision1_ac6Reading.verifiedInCode: GuidedActionGuard.sideEffecting (:168-176): non click/press kinds -> false; press -> "Enter".equals(key) || inForm(node); click -> node == null || !provenNonActivating(node). provenNonActivating (:183-192) is exactly the three triples. Stance branch (:154-164): DENY -> SIDE_EFFECT_DENIED; CLARIFY_FIRST unconfirmed -> confirmFirst; otherwise (ALLOW) Decision(null, sideEffecting, false), so ALLOW never refuses on this axis.
reasons: The AC defines the class by effect (submission, navigation); the observation is the evidence source. The observation cannot mark submission reliably: formId is null for unlabelled forms, withheld forms and form= association (ruling V1-V3), role spoofs pass the old exemption (V8), and label/descendant activation is invisible (I1, inferred by @architect).

Verified by @po at studio-runner/test/fixtures/secret-login/server.ts:12.
Story goal ('the first Run can never click, submit … something nobody asked for') and the QA focus area 'fail-closed defaults' (story Self-Healing line) require fail-closed.
Monotone: every action refused before is still refused; AC-6 nowhere promises that non-marked actions pass under DENY.
